title: test_agent_scheduler: remove the stale fallback safety names
description: Requested by the owner on 2026-11-22. indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c lines 47-53 define fallback values for AGENT_AUX_SAFETY_PROPERTY_NAME and AGENT_AUX_SAFETY_SAFE_ITEM_NAME under the comment 'the names of the safety of the Auxiliary Agent, until its header provides them'. Since commit 0ee7bddca, indigo_drivers/agent_auxiliary/indigo_agent_auxiliary.h (included at line 45) defines both names, so the comment is stale and the #ifndef block is dead code. Remove the comment and the block, so a renamed header name fails the build instead of being silently replaced. Test-only change: no driver behaviour or version changes. Verify that test_agent_scheduler still builds and its suite passes.

outcome.summary: Diff (master...HEAD, no uncommitted changes outside .factory2) is 8 deletions in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c only: the stale comment and both #ifndef fallbacks; one blank line remains between the auxiliary header include and #if defined(__SANITIZE_ADDRESS__). indigo_drivers/agent_auxiliary/indigo_agent_auxiliary.h lines 50-51 define AGENT_AUX_SAFETY_PROPERTY_NAME "AGENT_AUX_SAFETY" and AGENT_AUX_SAFETY_SAFE_ITEM_NAME "SAFE" unconditionally (same values), and the test includes it at line 45; the only uses (lines 981-982) resolve. git grep: other users (agent_auxiliary.c, test_agent_auxiliary.c) take the names from the header, no other fallback dependency. gcc -fsyntax-only (with _GNU_SOURCE and SEQUENCER_JS_PATH supplied as the Makefile would) completes with no errors. No defects.
